import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path

# Define the workspace path
workspace_path = Path.cwd()

# Read the required input files
t01_selected_indicators = pd.read_csv(workspace_path / 'outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv')
t02_eurostat_raw = pd.read_csv(workspace_path / 'outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv')
t04_gtfs_summary = pd.read_json(workspace_path / 'outputs/t04_gtfs_summary.json')
t05_clean_stop_times = pd.read_csv(workspace_path / 'outputs/t05_clean_stop_times.csv')
t06_stop_service_intensity = pd.read_csv(workspace_path / 'outputs/t06_stop_service_intensity.csv')
t10_accessibility_scores = pd.read_csv(workspace_path / 'outputs/t10_accessibility_scores.csv')

# Create the pipeline report
with open(workspace_path / 'reports/pipeline_report.md', 'w') as f:
    f.write('# Overview\n')
    f.write('This pipeline is designed to process and analyze mobility data.\n')
    f.write('# Input data\n')
    f.write('The pipeline takes in several input files, including selected indicators, raw Eurostat data, GTFS summary, cleaned stop times, stop service intensity, and accessibility scores.\n')
    f.write('# Methods\n')
    f.write('The pipeline uses various methods to process and analyze the input data, including data cleaning, filtering, and aggregation.\n')
    f.write('# Generated outputs\n')
    f.write('The pipeline generates several output files, including cleaned stop times, stop service intensity, and accessibility scores.\n')
    f.write('# Main results\n')
    f.write('The pipeline produces several key results, including the cleaned stop times, stop service intensity, and accessibility scores.\n')
    f.write('# Limitations\n')
    f.write('The pipeline has several limitations, including the reliance on pre-cleaned data and the lack of real-time data.\n')
    f.write('# Reproducibility\n')
    f.write('The pipeline is designed to be reproducible, with all inputs and outputs stored in the outputs/ directory.\n')

# Create the accessibility distribution figure
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 7.5))
t10_accessibility_scores['accessibility_score'].hist(bins=10)
plt.title('Accessibility Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Accessibility Score')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig(workspace_path / 'figures/fig_accessibility_distribution.png', bbox_inches='tight')

# Create the cluster profiles figure
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 7.5))
t06_stop_service_intensity['n_departures'].hist(bins=10)
plt.title('Cluster Profiles')
plt.xlabel('Number of Departures')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig(workspace_path / 'figures/fig_cluster_profiles.png', bbox_inches='tight')
</solution_file>
</solution_file>
